query:
ALTER TABLE `enterprise_geo_profiles`
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `brandName` text NULL,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `industryTag` text NULL,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `productDesc` text NULL,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `mainChannel` text NULL,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `targetCustomer` text NULL,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `customerPains` json NULL,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `competitors` json NULL,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `hasCases` tinyint(1) NULL DEFAULT 0,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `oneLiner` text NULL,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `keyPoints` json NULL,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `keywords` json NULL;
UPDATE `enterprise_geo_profiles`
SET
  `brandName` = `enterpriseName`,
  `industryTag` = NULLIF(TRIM(`industry`), ''),
  `targetCustomer` = NULLIF(TRIM(`targetCustomers`), ''),
  `productDesc` = CASE
    WHEN TRIM(COALESCE(`productServiceIntro`, '')) <> '' THEN TRIM(`productServiceIntro`)
    WHEN TRIM(COALESCE(`productIntro`, '')) <> '' THEN TRIM(`productIntro`)
    WHEN TRIM(COALESCE(`coreSellingPoints`, '')) <> '' THEN TRIM(`coreSellingPoints`)
    ELSE NULL
  END
WHERE `brandName` IS NULL;
